# Exponent

> > Exponent is Solana's yield exchange and interest rate protocol enabling users to trade and manage DeFi yields with fixed-rate swaps and liquidity provision.

Exponent operates on Solana as a specialized DeFi platform for yield markets, supporting assets like JitoSOL and other LSTs. The platform recently launched Exponent v2 with a rebrand and is currently in private beta for select users and asset issuers.

## Key Topics

- Solana DeFi
- Yield Exchange
- Interest Rate Protocol
- Fixed-Rate Swaps
- JitoSOL
- PT-JitoSOL
- LST (Liquid Staking Tokens)
- Liquidity Provision
- Yield Markets
- DeFi Yields
- Vault Management
- Asset Issuers
- Exponent v2
- RWA (Real World Assets)
